verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that Superhuman can trash or mark done all messages from the same sender in one action. That is a sender-scoped bulk action, not arbitrary multi-select of conversations, and no documentation covers bulk archive or bulk label. Auto Archive and Auto Labels are automatic AI classification, not user-driven bulk actions, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented arbitrary multi-select of conversations, bulk archive and bulk label on a selection, first-party docs for bulk triage.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke

citations.quote: When deleting, you can trash or mark done all messages from the same sender.
